nodes.name: Remotive Due? (3x/day)
nodes.notes: Remotive allows max 4 calls/day, so it is only fetched at 8 AM, 4 PM and 8 PM.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO radar_leads (source, external_id, title, company, url, location, budget, client_info, description, posted_at)
SELECT source, external_id, title, company, url, location, budget, client_info, description, posted_at
FROM json_populate_recordset(NULL::radar_leads, $1::json)
ON CONFLICT (source, external_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, source, title, company, url, location, budget, client_info, description;

parameters.jsCode:
// Skip runs where every lead was already saved before (duplicates are ignored by the database)
return $input.all().filter(i => i.json.id);

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'openai/gpt-oss-120b', temperature: 0.2, reasoning_effort: 'low', max_completion_tokens: 700, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: "You screen freelance and remote job posts for Adnan, a solo full-stack developer in Lahore, Pakistan (brand: Infinity AI). His skills: website development and web apps (React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, Supabase or Postgres), API development and third-party integrations, e-commerce websites and Shopify stores, payment gateway integration, WhatsApp bots and WhatsApp Business API automation, AI chatbots and AI agents (OpenAI or Groq LLMs, RAG), voice AI, and n8n, Make or Zapier workflow automation. Proof of work: haps.pk (healthcare client) and Nexus Ops, an open-source n8n AI lead pipeline. FIRST judge trust in the client or employer. trust = high: an established, named company or a verified client with a good review history, and a clear, professional post. trust = medium: a named company or verified client but with limited history, or a post that is a little vague. trust = low: unknown or unnamed poster, no verifiable company, vague or copy-paste post, pay that is unrealistically high for the work, requests to pay a fee, buy anything, or move to Telegram or WhatsApp before hiring, crypto or MLM schemes, commission-only pay, or anything that looks like a scam. Adnan only wants reliable, trustworthy clients, so when unsure choose the lower trust level. THEN score fit. Score 80-100 = strong fit: matches his skills, open to remote workers in Pakistan or worldwide, contract or project work, realistic for one person. Score 50-79 = partial fit. Score 0-49 = poor fit: mostly unrelated skills, onsite, restricted to US or EU residents only, needs citizenship or clearance, unpaid or equity only, very senior full-time role in an unrelated stack. If trust is low the score must be below 40. Respond ONLY with valid JSON, no markdown: {"trust": "high|medium|low", "score": <integer 0-100>, "fit": "strong|partial|poor", "reason": "<one short sentence covering trust and fit>", "suggested_pitch": "<two-sentence opening line Adnan could send, mentioning relevant proof>"}" }, { role: 'user', content: 'Source: ' + $json.source + '
Title: ' + $json.title + '
Company: ' + ($json.company || 'n/a') + '
Location: ' + ($json.location || 'n/a') + '
Budget: ' + ($json.budget || 'n/a') + '
Client: ' + ($json.client_info || 'n/a') + '
Description: ' + ($json.description || '') } ] }) }}

parameters.query:
UPDATE radar_leads
SET score = $1, fit = $2, reason = $3, suggested_pitch = $4, trust = $5, status = 'scored'
WHERE id = $6
RETURNING id;
